name: Vosne-Romanée

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Noir sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
Bourgogne, village, Premier Cru, Grand Cru
Burgundy's four levels, from regional Bourgogne up through village wines to Premier Cru and Grand Cru vineyards.
keyfacts: There are six Grand Cru vineyards in Vosne-Romanée and two in Flagey-Échezeaux, plus 14 Premier Cru vineyards across the two communes.
Romanée-Conti and La Tâche are monopoles of Domaine de la Romanée-Conti.
Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris may be interplanted among the vines, up to 15% in total in each parcel.

notes: Vosne-Romanée is often described as combining elegance with power.
The wines are racy and elegant, and they often need long cellaring to develop fully.

blurb.text: A Côte de Nuits village in Burgundy, used only for red wine, mainly from Pinot Noir. It has six Grand Cru vineyards, including Romanée-Conti, among Burgundy's most iconic red wines, plus two in neighboring Flagey-Échezeaux.
